articles.summary: Healthcare providers are often overwhelmed by the increasing demands of their roles, facing mounting patient loads and an endless stream of administrative tasks. This time crunch can lead to burnout, decreased patient satisfaction, and compromised care quality. Collaborative care management emerges as a promising solution to alleviate these pressures. By fostering teamwork and shared responsibilities, this model can significantly enhance time management and efficiency within healthcare settings.
articles.title: Collaborative Care: A Time-Saver for Healthcare Providers
